environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' with ClusterIP service (no external LB). Ingress path: CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net) with Origin type custom-origin pointing to internal ALB (not NLB). CloudFront behavior configured with Trusted Key Group (kg-9f8e7d6c) requiring Ed25519 signed URLs with 300s TTL policy. Origin custom header X-CF-Secret-Token verified by ALB listener rule (priority 1) which returns 403 for requests missing the header. VPC security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e restricts ALB ingress to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). Pod NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to ALB security group CIDR only. The CloudFront signed URL policy includes a custom policy condition restricting the request payload size to 2048 bytes and the URL path must match /api/v1/user/read/* — write operations (CreateUser, UpdateUser) are not included in any signed URL path pattern issued by the application's URL signer Lambda.

config.grpc_web_proxy: envoy sidecar translating HTTP/1.1 to gRPC
